newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Senator questions Barshefsky's nomination.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Senator questions Barshefsky's nomination.

text.p: Senate Finance Committee Chairman William Roth, R-Delaware, questioned Charlene Barshefsky's nomination Friday as U.S. Trade Representative.
"There is a question of whether her service for the government of Canada would require some form of waiver for her to be confirmed," Roth said in a statement.
Roth's committee would be responsible for confirming Barshefsky.
Barshefsky represented Canadian lumber interests while she was a Washington lawyer.

However, Roth said he was pleased that Clinton had nominated Barshefsky, who he said was doing an outstanding job as acting Trade Representative. He added that he hoped the Senate would be able to confirm her.
